title: Settings
subtitle: Manage API access, interface preferences, default folders, and assistant behavior.
extensionsDesc: Manage settings contributed by enabled extensions.
subagentsSettingsIntro: Manage runtime policy, models, reasoning effort, prompts, and capability access for delegatable subagents. These settings stay in sync with the workbench side panel.
subagentsRuntimePolicyDesc: Set delegation concurrency; excess tasks wait in the queue.
subagentsUseExistingAgentsDesc: On: delegate_task routes to configured profiles. Off: the main agent defines a one-run role for each task.
subagentsMaxParallelDesc: New tasks wait in the queue after this many subagents are running at once.
subagentsProactiveRetryDesc: Let the main agent decide whether to continue an eligible failed subagent in the same session.
subagentsProactiveRetryAttemptsDesc: Limit model-initiated continuations per subagent to between one and three.
subagentsDelegatableDesc: Configure built-in delegation roles or create custom profiles for delegation and primary-agent personas.
subagentsAutomaticRolesDesc: Choose models for internal work such as context compaction, code review, titles, and summaries.
writeDesc: Configure the Work space, Markdown editing, Office/PDF previews, typography, suggestions, selection tools, and assistant.
designDesc: Configure design-to-code, canvas behavior, and the design workspace.
shortcutsDesc: Review and customize global keyboard shortcuts for common actions.
terminalColorModeDesc: By default the terminal follows the app's native terminal style and shows shell ANSI colors. Switch to No color to make the terminal monochrome.
terminalColorModeNativeDesc: The terminal uses the built-in light/dark palette and keeps ANSI colors from shell prompts, command output, and programs.
terminalColorModeNoneDesc: All terminal text is shown in a single color. Commands will not appear in red, avoiding confusion with error messages. Switch to Custom colors if you want syntax highlighting.
terminalColorSurfaceDesc: Basic terminal colors for text, background, cursor, and selection.
terminalColorAnsiDesc: Colors used by shell programs for syntax highlighting, ls --color, git status, etc.
llmDebugDesc: Inspect the latest 25 raw model requests and outputs. Credentials are redacted; captured Agent Perspective content is stored privately on this device and removed with its conversation.
llmDebugCaptureSettingsDesc: Each conversation has its own capture switch. Captured request and response content stays on this device.
llmDebugDefaultCaptureDesc: Sets the initial switch state for newly created conversations. Existing conversations keep their current state.
llmDebugEmpty: No records yet. Send a message, then click Refresh.
llmDebugRequest: Request (HTTP body sent to the model)
llmDebugSelectRequestDesc: Choose a record on the left to inspect its details.
laboratorySettingsDesc: Configure experimental agent capabilities. Features here may change as they evolve.
archivesOverviewDesc: Review chats that were removed from the active sidebar. You can open, restore, or permanently delete them here.
archivesSearchEmpty: No archived chats match your search.
archivesOffline: Connect the local runtime to refresh archived chats.
archivesDeleteConfirmDesc: This archived chat will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
clawEnabledDesc: When enabled, the Feishu / Lark phone bridge and local IM webhook can run in the background. Turning it off does not affect normal GUI chats.
clawDefaultWorkspaceDesc: Leave this empty to use the GUI default working directory. Individual phone connections can still override it.
clawManageAgentsEmpty: No phone agent has been connected yet. Use Connect phone to bind Feishu / Lark first.
clawManageAgentNamePlaceholder: Name shown in the IM sidebar
clawManageAgentDescriptionPlaceholder: Example: Handles project questions in the team chat
clawManageAgentIdentityPlaceholder: Define who this agent is, its role, scope, and boundaries.
clawManageAgentPersonalityPlaceholder: Define tone, style, patience, and when it should ask follow-up questions.
clawManageAgentUserContextPlaceholder: Long-lived user, team, or workflow context this phone agent should remember.
clawManageAgentReplyRulesPlaceholder: Define reply format, length, risk checks, or confirmation rules.
clawTelegramConnectDesc: Enter the Bot Token from @BotFather so this computer can receive Telegram private messages.
clawTelegramConnectStep1: Open Telegram, then search for and open @BotFather.
clawTelegramConnectStep2: Send /newbot, follow the prompts to set the bot name and username, then copy the Bot Token.
clawTelegramConnectStep3: Paste the Bot Token below. To restrict access to specific private chats, enter their Chat IDs.
clawTelegramConnectStep4: Click Connect, then send the bot a private message in Telegram to start using it.
clawTelegramConnectedHint: {{bot}} is connected and its credentials are saved locally. Kun creates or restores the matching conversation when you open this IM channel or when the first Telegram private message arrives. Phone-connection conversations live in the IM view, not in the main project list.
clawSkillAllowlistDesc: One skill name per line. Phone connections and scheduled tasks use these skill hints first.
clawExtraSkillDirsDesc: Optional local skill folders to make available to the AI assistant.
clawPromptPrefixDesc: Added before phone messages and scheduled task prompts.
clawPromptPrefixPlaceholder: Example: You are my personal automation assistant. Identify the source before answering.
codePromptPrefixDesc: These instructions are injected before every Code mode conversation. Use for global rules, coding conventions, or persistent preferences.
codePromptPrefixPlaceholder: Example: Always write unit tests for new code. Prefer functional components over class components. Use TypeScript strict mode conventions.
clawRunModeDesc: Default handling mode for phone messages and scheduled tasks.
clawFeishuStreamDesc: Stream the reply character-by-character in a live SDK card, instead of sending a one-shot message after the run completes.
clawModelDesc: Choose automatic, Pro, or Flash model routing.
clawWorkspaceOverrideDesc: Leave empty to use the default working directory.
clawTasksDesc: Each task sends its prompt to the AI assistant on the configured schedule.
clawTaskPromptPlaceholder: Example: Summarize recent workspace changes and list follow-ups.
themeDesc: Light, dark, or match the operating system.
onboardingPreviewDesc: Reopen the basic setup flow shown on first launch.
legacyImportDesc: Bring conversations from a previous DeepSeek GUI installation into Kun.
legacyImportNoneFound: No previous conversations found on this computer.
legacyImportResultNone: No conversations were found to import.
legacyImportRestartDetail: Imported {{count}} conversation(s). Restart the runtime now to load them into the sidebar?
fontScaleDesc: Adjust the overall UI text size.
chatContentMaxWidthDesc: Adjust how wide chat messages and the composer are displayed.
composerSendKeyDesc: Choose whether Enter or Shift+Enter sends a message; the other inserts a new line.
composerSendKey_enter: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for new line
composerSendKey_shiftEnter: Shift+Enter to send · Enter for new line
chatWelcomeMessageDesc: Title shown on the empty chat home screen. Leave blank to use the default for the current language.
chatWelcomeMessagePlaceholder: What would you like to do with Kun today?
cursorSpotlightDesc: Show a soft cursor-follow spotlight on the title bar and sidebar.
cursorSpotlightColorDesc: Use the tone bar to tune the spotlight from deep to bright. The default keeps Kun's current soft blue.
darkUiColorsBackgroundDesc: Base color for the app, sidebar, canvas, and ghost surfaces.
darkUiColorsBorderDesc: Base color for dividers, outlines, and control borders.
darkUiColorsPanelDesc: Base color for cards, panels, chips, and hover surfaces.
darkUiColorsDarkOnlyHint: Applies to Kun's standard dark theme. Appearance packs keep their own colors.
turnCompleteNotificationDesc: Show a native Windows/macOS notification when the AI assistant finishes replying.
mainAgentTurnCompleteNotificationDesc: Show a system notification when a main or forked conversation completes.
subagentTurnCompleteNotificationDesc: Show a system notification when a subagent session completes.
desktopKeepAwakeDesc: Prevent the computer from sleeping while Kun is running so background agents and scheduled tasks can continue. The display may still turn off or lock.
desktopOpenAtLoginDesc: Start Kun automatically after you sign in.
desktopOpenAtLoginUnsupportedDesc: Open at login is available on Windows and macOS.
desktopStartMinimizedDesc: Keep the main window hidden during Windows login startup.
desktopStartMinimizedDisabledDesc: Enable Open at login first. This option applies to Windows startup.
desktopUseSystemTitleBarDesc: Let the Linux desktop environment or window manager draw the title bar. Restart Kun to apply.
desktopCloseToTrayDesc: Hide the window to the system tray when it is closed.
desktopCloseActionDesc: Choose what happens when the main window close button is pressed.
shortcutCaptureHint: Press the new shortcut. Press Esc to cancel.
shortcutTogglePlanModeDesc: Switch the composer between Agent and Plan mode.
shortcutNewChatDesc: Start a new chat in the current workspace.
shortcutToggleTerminalDesc: Open or close the terminal panel.
shortcutCommandPaletteDesc: Open the command palette to search commands, conversations, and settings.
shortcutSelectAllDesc: Select content in the focused view.
shortcutToggleMaximizeDesc: Maximize or restore the main window.
kunProviderDesc: Configure one or more OpenAI-compatible providers for the Agent. Each provider can have its own API key, service URL, and model list.
kunProviderSelectDesc: Choose one of the configured providers from the Providers tab.
providersDesc: API keys, service URLs, text models, and image capabilities live here. Assistant, Work, and image generation reuse these profiles.
modelProviderConfigFileHint: Edit the file directly, then reload the app to apply your changes.
modelProviderConfigOpenFailed: Could not open the configuration file.

modelRoutes.gatewayMultipleModelsDesc: One local relay provider can contain multiple public models.
modelRoutes.testCreateFailed: Unable to create the route test
modelRoutes.providerDesc: One provider serves multiple public models, each with independent route targets and load strategy.
modelRoutes.runtimeUnavailableHint: Local settings are unaffected and will sync automatically when Kun starts.
modelRoutes.apiCompatibilityDesc: Compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses. Public model IDs come from the routed models below.
modelRoutes.copyCurlUnavailable: Enable at least one route with an enabled target before copying an example.
modelRoutes.choosePool: Select a model to configure its target pool.
modelRoutes.hotUpdateHint: Saved configuration hot-updates the active Kun Runtime.
modelRoutes.publicModelIdDuplicate: Public model ID {{modelId}} is already used by another route.
modelRoutes.routeTargetsHint: Enable the targets that may receive requests. Drag or use the arrows to set priority.
modelRoutes.addTargetUnavailable: Add a provider with at least one model before adding a route target.
modelRoutes.weightInactive: Weight is only used by weighted round robin.
modelRoutes.providerMissingWarning: Provider {{providerId}} no longer exists. The reference was preserved; choose a replacement provider or delete this target.
modelRoutes.modelMissingWarning: Model {{modelId}} is no longer available from {{providerId}}. The reference was preserved; choose a replacement model or delete this target.
modelRoutes.confirmDeleteModel: Delete routed model {{modelId}} and all of its targets?
modelRoutes.failoverStatusesInvalid: Use comma- or space-separated HTTP status codes from 400 to 599.
modelRoutes.afterStreamNoRetry: After streaming output begins, the request stops in place and will not retry or execute tools again.
modelRoutes.routeValidationDesc: Kun Runtime runs tests asynchronously. They continue after you leave and restore progress and results when you return.
modelRoutes.blockedSaveFailed: Local save failed. Retry the save first; unsaved configuration is not used for route tests.
modelRoutes.blockedSaving: Configuration is being saved locally. Testing is available after saving and Kun Runtime sync complete.
modelRoutes.blockedInvalidTargets: This route has {{count}} invalid references and no executable target. Replace the provider or model first.
modelRoutes.blockedNoTargets: This route has no enabled valid targets. Add or enable a target first.
modelRoutes.blockedSyncFailed: Local configuration was saved, but Kun Runtime sync failed. Check the Runtime logs and retry saving.
modelRoutes.blockedSyncFailedWithMessage: Local configuration was saved, but Kun Runtime sync failed. {{message}}
modelRoutes.blockedRuntimeUnavailable: Local configuration was saved, but Kun Runtime is unavailable and will sync automatically after startup.
modelRoutes.blockedRuntimeUnavailableWithMessage: Local configuration was saved, but Kun Runtime is unavailable and will sync automatically after startup. {{message}}
modelRoutes.blockedWaitingForSync: Local configuration was saved and is waiting for Kun Runtime to apply the same route pools and local API state.
modelRoutes.blockedRuntimeNotReady: Kun Runtime is not ready to test this complete route yet.
modelRoutes.apiDialogDesc: OpenAI-compatible endpoints for local processes only; no Authorization header is required.
modelRoutes.prerequisitesDesc: Enable the local API and at least one routed model. Use its public model ID in the request's model field.
modelRoutes.apiSecurityWarning: This relay is not a public API service. It binds only to the local loopback address and currently has no authentication. Do not expose it to a LAN or the internet through port forwarding or an unprotected reverse proxy.
modelRoutes.guideModelsDesc: Lists all enabled routed models in the local relay. Each returned data[].id is the public model ID used by generation requests.
modelRoutes.guideModelsEnabledOnly: Only enabled routed models are returned; disabled or invalid pools are omitted.
modelRoutes.guideModelsResponse: A successful response uses the OpenAI-style object: "list" and a data array.
modelRoutes.guideModelsDisabled: Returns 404 (gateway_disabled) when the local API is disabled.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesDesc: Generates content in the OpenAI Responses format for clients that send input as a single request value.
modelRoutes.guideFieldModel: model: Required. Use a public model ID such as {{modelId}}.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesInput: input: Required. Accepts a string or message array.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesStream: stream: Optional. true returns Server-Sent Events.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesOptional: max_output_tokens, tools, and reasoning_effort are optional.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesNonStreaming: A non-streaming response uses object: "response" with text in output.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesStreaming: A streaming response emits response.created, response.output_text.delta, and response.completed in order.
modelRoutes.guideChatDesc: Generates a conversation response in the OpenAI Chat Completions format used by most OpenAI-compatible SDKs.
modelRoutes.guideChatMessages: messages: Required and non-empty. Supports system, developer, user, assistant, and tool messages.
modelRoutes.guideChatStream: stream: Optional. true returns SSE; false returns complete JSON.
modelRoutes.guideChatTools: tools: Optional. Uses OpenAI function tool definitions; images accept Base64 data URLs only.
modelRoutes.exampleResponsesPrompt: Introduce the Kun local gateway in one sentence.

modelProviderIdentityHint: Default and preset provider IDs are locked. Custom IDs identify this provider in routing and settings references.
modelProviderProxyState_active: Active: Kun-owned requests for this provider use the app proxy.
modelProviderProxyState_direct: Direct: this provider does not use the app proxy.
modelProviderProxyState_inactive: Selected but inactive because the global proxy is disabled.
modelProviderProxyState_invalid: Selected, but the enabled global proxy configuration is invalid.
modelProviderProxyState_unsupported: Unsupported for this delegated SDK or CLI transport.
modelProviderProxyScope: Applies to Kun-controlled requests, including models, quota, media, and app-owned token calls. External browsers and delegated SDK/CLI traffic use their own network settings.
modelProviderAddDialogDesc: Choose a preset or create a custom provider.
modelProviderAddCustomDesc: Start with a blank provider and configure its endpoint and models.
modelProviderIdLocked: Default and preset provider IDs cannot be changed
claudeSubTosNote: Personal use: draws on your own Claude Pro/Max subscription via the official Claude Agent SDK (Claude Code is bundled — no separate install). A one-time login is required; this app does not provide Claude accounts or web login.
claudeSubStatusChecking: Checking for a local Claude Code login…
claudeSubStatusLoggedIn: Local Claude Code login detected — the token below can be left empty.
claudeSubStatusLoggedOut: No local login detected — log in or paste a subscription token.
claudeSubStatusToken: Long-lived subscription token configured — use Test connection to verify it.
claudeSubSdkMissing: Subscription runtime not installed (~222MB, downloaded once on first use)
claudeSubLoginSuccess: Local Claude login completed. Kun did not store account credentials.
claudeSubLoginFailedCli: Couldn't start login: the bundled Claude binary wasn't found (run npm install in kun) and no `claude` is on PATH. You can paste a token manually instead.
claudeSubLoginFailedTimeout: Authorization timed out (5 min). Please retry.
claudeSubManualPlaceholder: Paste the token from claude setup-token, or leave empty to use the local login
claudeSubTokenSetHint: Token set — it will be used for subscription auth.
claudeSubTokenInvalid: Invalid token format. Paste only the complete value beginning with sk-ant-oat; do not include Bearer, a variable name, quotes, or whitespace.
claudeSubEmptyHint: Leave empty to use the local Claude Code login credentials.
claudeSubProbeNotReady: The real Claude authentication test failed. Log in again or check the long-lived token.
claudeSubProbeTimeout: The real Claude authentication test timed out. Check your network and try again.
claudeSubModelsEmpty: No models returned (log in first); kept the current list
modelProviderRetryMaxAttemptsHint: Applies to eligible transport failures and the HTTP statuses listed below. Excludes the initial request; default 5, maximum 10.
modelProviderRetryStatusCodesHint: Separate multiple status codes with commas. Current defaults: 429,500,502,503,504.
modelEndpointCustomEndpointDesc: Uses this URL as the final endpoint. Only paths ending in /chat/completions, /completions, /responses, or /messages can be recognized; other endings are not supported.
modelProviderModelsPlaceholder: Type a model ID and press Enter
providerModelListDesc: Add models here when the provider ships new ones, or fetch them from the API. Text, image, speech, music, and video models are grouped by capability; the sections below control protocol and endpoint details.
providerModelEmpty: No models yet. Click "Add model" to configure one, or use "Fetch from API".
providerModelKindLabel: What kind of model is this?
providerModelAdvancedDesc: Context, output, reasoning protocol, endpoint, and aliases.
